## Appearance

Alonzo possesses a classic nose. It is described as a dependable facial feature within his family.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P56](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0056)_

## Personality

Alonzo is regarded as a nice and manly individual. His pleasant demeanor makes it difficult for others to judge whether he or another is the nicer person.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Yesterday P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000)_

## Relationships

### [Alec](../character/alec.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/alec--alonzo.md)

Alonzo and [Alec](../character/alec.md) are rivals who are both competing as suitors for [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) Gordon's hand. Their connection stems from this shared pursuit, creating natural romantic tension between them during their time in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Park P6](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0006), [v3 ch.Interlude P24](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0024), [v3 ch.Yesterday P4](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0004), +3 more_

- Rival of — suitors competing for Phil Gordon's hand  <sub>[v3 ch.Park P6](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0006), [v3 ch.Interlude P24](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0024)</sub>

### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/alonzo--phil-gordon.md)

Alonzo is romantically involved with [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) as one of the suitors actively competing for her hand. He accompanies her during her stay in [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), where she engages in personal visits to her birthplace and her parents' grave.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Again P52](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0052), [v3 ch.Relationships P4](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0004), [v3 ch.Interlude P24](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0024), +5 more_
